scope: Source-level architectural audit of selected paths in every listed project; acquisition is not a claim that every acquired line was manually audited. No runtime benchmark was executed.
limitations: Current Codeberg repositories for anametologin/Krohnkite and Serroda/fluid-tile could not be read. GitHub snapshots may lag current upstream.
KWin development branch is not a compatibility baseline. Stable branch snapshots have separate immutable refs.
Issue reports are unverified workload leads, not current-version verdicts.
